definitions.explanation: The premier professional basketball league in North America, featuring the world's top players.

examples.japanese: NBAの{試合|しあい}を{見|み}る。
{彼|かれ}の{夢|ゆめ}はNBA{選手|せんしゅ}になることだ。
examples.english: His dream is to become an NBA player.

examples.japanese: NBAファイナルは{毎年|まいとし}6{月|がつ}に{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: The NBA Finals are held every year in June.

notes:
NBA stands for "National Basketball Association," the top professional basketball league in North America. In Japanese, read as えぬびーえー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- NBA{選手|せんしゅ} (NBA player)
- NBAファイナル (NBA Finals)
- NBAドラフト (NBA Draft)
- NBA{公式|こうしき} (official NBA)
- NBAオールスター (NBA All-Star)

PRONUNCIATION:
Like most English-origin acronyms in Japanese, each letter is pronounced individually using the Japanese reading of the English letter names: エヌ・ビー・エー.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The NBA has grown in popularity in Japan, especially with Japanese players like {八村|はちむら}{塁|るい} and {渡邊|わたなべ}{雄太|ゆうた} playing in the league. NBA{中継|ちゅうけい} (NBA broadcasts) are available on Japanese streaming services.

RELATED WORDS:
- バスケ/バスケットボール: basketball
- Bリーグ: Japan's professional basketball league
